_note: JSON sidecar for migration-manifest.yaml. The wizard runtime CLI consumes JSON; YAML is the human-facing companion. Both files MUST stay in sync.

artifact_notes.agents/lib/external_write/_ext_write_sta: New internal helper: the single place the system decides whether an unrebuilt hand-rolled external-write file is still open, plus a self-heal that clears that flag once the file is rebuilt or gone. You never call it directly.
artifact_notes.agents/lib/external_write/capability_hea: The health check now reports not-normal for the whole project -- and names the exact file(s) to rebuild -- whenever a hand-rolled writer still bypasses the safety-gated write surface, and treats an unreadable check as blocking rather than reporting a false all-clear.
artifact_notes.agents/lib/external_write/lifecycle_stat: The done/completion check now reports not-done for the whole project, and names the file(s) to fix, while any such bypass is open; and it self-heals -- once you rebuild the flagged file, the block clears on its own the next time the check runs.
artifact_notes.agents/lib/external_write/operator_accep: Turning a capability on now refuses to go live while any hand-rolled writer bypasses the sanctioned, safety-gated write surface, and tells you exactly which file to rebuild -- so nothing can be marked ready around an unrebuilt writer. Repair stays available while the capability is paused.
artifact_notes.agents/lib/external_write/zones.py: Marks the new internal state helper as a sealed internal module so a capability cannot import it directly.
Carries the matching guidance for rebuilding a flagged hand-rolled writer through the sanctioned write path so turning the capability on succeeds.

migrations.migration_steps: 1. Run the update check (it reports what's new + the recommendation). 2. On the operator's yes, the assistant applies it ("${{WIZARD_HOME:-$HOME/agent-wizard}}/scripts/wizard" self-upgrade --to v0.19.0 --apply). 3. A backup is taken first; the operator's own data, rules, credentials, and logs are never touched.
migrations.notes: Minor-additive release to v0.19.0 (Cut 1.5). Reliability fix that closes a false-green in turning capabilities on: (1) turning a capability on now refuses to go live while any hand-rolled file writes to your external world by a path that bypasses the sanctioned, safety-gated write surface -- previously a capability could be marked ready around such an unrebuilt writer; (2) whenever an open bypass like that exists anywhere in the project, the health check and the completion check now report not-normal / not-done for the whole project and name the exact file(s) to rebuild, and they fail safe (treat an unreadable queue as blocking) rather than reporting a false all-clear; and (3) once you rebuild the flagged file through the sanctioned path, the block clears on its own the next time the check runs. No breaking changes; all existing capabilities and files are unaffected.
migrations.preflight: Verify the operator project carries a .wizard/manifest.json whose foundation_bundle_version is v0.18.0 (or any version in the supported range). A backup is taken automatically.
migrations.rollback: Restore from .wizard/backups/pre-v0.19.0/ and set foundation_bundle_version back to v0.18.0.
